The age limit for a newborn baby to be considered covered is up to 90 days from birth. [p.12] Under the SBIGeneral Alpha policy, a baby born during the Policy Year is covered from day one up to 90 days of age. [p.12] Under the HDFC ERGO Easy Health policy, children aged between 1 to 90 days can be covered if the Newborn Baby Benefit is added. [p.11] The HDFC ERGO Optima Restore policy defines a New Born Baby as aged up to 90 days. [p.7]
